data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2020 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 43.15m. During 2020 there was a small net favourable prior-year reserve movement driven by favourable development on older underwriting years (notably a reduction in the 2018 gross estimate), partially offset by property major losses and COVID-19 related reserve recognition. The gross prior-year movement derived from the syndicate's gross claims development table indicates a release of approximately GBP 3.5m (around 8.1% of opening gross reserves). The report also records net favourable prior year development of GBP 6.6m (net of reinsurance) and cites major loss events (Hurricane Sally, Typhoon Faxai, Hagibis) and COVID-19 as key influences on claims experience.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include favourable prior year development of GBP 6.6m (2019: GBP 1.8m).
The net loss ratio of 96% (2019: 78%) reflects the impact of major losses, notably Hurricane Sally on the Property lines.
Additional reserves have also been recognised in relation to potential COVID-19 losses, adding 3.7 percentage points to the net claims ratio.
The 2019 result included the Syndicate's exposure to two loss events, Typhoon Faxai and Hagibis.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior year development gross figure derived from gross claims development triangle (comparison of 2018 diagonal: change from 28,901 to 25,399 = -3,502 GBP 000 = -3.502m). The report also discloses a net prior year favourable development of GBP 6.6m (net of reinsurance) in narrative; LOB-level prior year movements in the note are presented net of reinsurance and were used for LOB directional indicators only (amounts there are NET). No explicit gross prior-year movement by LOB was provided. Confidence scores reflect use of the gross triangle (0.8) and direct balance sheet figures (1.0).
